clips.title: The story
paras: Bishop Farthing is a human clergyman residing within the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. To visitors and worshippers, he presents himself as a devout servant of the Holy Light who guides parishioners and directs aid toward beleaguered settlements across the kingdom.

Within the serene marble halls of the Cathedral of Light, Bishop Farthing stands as one of the prominent figures attending to the spiritual needs of Stormwind City. Alongside Archbishop Benedictus and the gathered clergy, he offers counsel to travelers, assists those pursuing the holy arts, and attends to the civic and pastoral obligations of the Church of the Holy Light.
